answer_1.quote: In the second stage, we leverage a summarization model to summarize the information in each of the captions in a short and succinct way ... suitable for use in visual description applications.

answer_2.quote: We introduce two novel automated measures of caption quality, which directly address information retrieval. CLIP Recall ... Content Coverage ... We also report CIDEr, BLEU@4, ROUGE-L, and MAUVE scores.

answer_4.quote: We perform two styles of human evaluation. In "context-free" evaluation, raters are asked to rate two components: The "Helpfulness" of the caption ... and the factual "Correctness" of the caption ... (Amazon Mechanical Turk).
answer_4.guideline: Raters rate each caption on Helpfulness (scale 0–4) and Correctness (scale 0–5) after viewing the image and caption.
